business_problem: SHARE NOW needed to process huge volumes of car telemetry and customer data in real time without forcing application teams to keep manually scaling and operating an increasingly complex self-managed database estate.
solution_summary: SHARE NOW moved its non-relational workloads to MongoDB Atlas to support a real-time car-sharing platform spread across thousands of vehicles and many European cities. Each vehicle acts as an IoT endpoint that streams status, booking, and maintenance signals into a central platform, so the company needed a database environment that could absorb constant schema variation and high event volume without slowing down development. Atlas now underpins more than 100 deployments and roughly 200 microservices, each with its own database, while also feeding a single-view environment that consolidates fleet, booking, and maintenance data. The flexible document model lets teams evolve individual services independently, and MongoDB Charts helps visualize operational patterns in real time. By shifting infrastructure management to Atlas, SHARE NOW kept its developers focused on customer features while maintaining high availability for a 24/7 mobility service.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the fleet, booking, and maintenance data for SHARE NOW's microservices and single-view operational platform.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Charts
solution_components.role: Visualizes real-time fleet and operational trends from the Atlas data platform.

data_flow: Vehicle sensors send events such as door unlocks, engine starts, and battery or fuel levels into the central IoT hub, Atlas-backed microservices route and store those events by business domain, the single-view platform consolidates them for query and analysis, and Charts renders trends for operators in real time.
business_outcome: SHARE NOW improved fleet visibility, reduced infrastructure overhead, and preserved a seamless 24/7 customer experience while expanding its car-sharing service across countries and cities.
metrics: SHARE NOW operates more than 11,000 vehicles across eight countries and 16 cities.
The company has more than 100 Atlas deployments and approximately 200 microservices.
The platform processes millions of events, equivalent to 2TB of data, per day.
architecture_clues: Each microservice owns its own database and is decoupled along business and data boundaries.
Atlas powers both the operational microservices estate and the single-view environment.
MongoDB Charts is used to visualize real-time trends from the mobility platform.
